description: Surface Pro 7 single-display variant of data/config.json. Coordinates are relative positions of the multi-display config's right monitor (origin 2560,0 / 2560x1440) rescaled to the Surface Pro 7 panel (2736x1824 physical pixels, x1.06875 / y1.26667).

target_display.name: Surface Pro 7 (single display)
target_display.note: mss calls SetProcessDPIAware(), so pyautogui coordinates are physical pixels, not the 200%-scaled 1368x912 logical size.
